Implementation Plan

This plan replaces the contents of `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` with the three lines the issue asks for. No other file changes.

Planning ref: `main` @ `f9b3ff877842fa8effe2e4c4eec3fc061b2efd5d` (integration branch mismatch: unknown, not `true`).

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Acceptance
ACCEPTANCE: check static-checks
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: data-only canary file change with no post-merge workflow dependency

## Functions or modules to implement
None. Overwrite the file so its exact bytes are:
`status: ok\nrun_id: 46172020453\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n`

The file currently holds two lines: `status: ok` and `decompose-run: 41445772297`.

## Data structures affected
Only the content of the canary text file.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Replace the whole file
- Chosen: overwrite the file with exactly the three lines, ending with a single trailing newline.
- Alternatives considered: editing only line 2 and adding line 3; this could leave stray bytes behind.
- Why: the issue says to replace the whole content.

## Security considerations
No trust boundary, endpoint, secret or external input is involved. The run_id is a public number. There is no abuse case.

## Potential risks or edge cases
- Several test files mention the file by name. A search found no test that reads its content or the old `decompose-run` value, so nothing should depend on the line being replaced.
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt` has the same old line. The issue rules out changing it, so it stays as it is.
- The file must end with exactly one newline: no trailing blank line, no CRLF.

## Testing considerations
Check the result with `cmp` against `printf 'status: ok\nrun_id: 46172020453\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n'`. Running `git diff --stat` should show only this file.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue fully specifies a single-file content replacement and forbids touching other files, so the scope is held exactly to that file and that content.
